_comment: Request for the device-evidence workflow (CLAUDE.md evidence source 1).
workflow_dispatch only reaches workflows present on the repository's
default branch, and this session's GitHub proxy refuses repository
settings writes, so the default branch cannot be moved to the working
branch. The workflow is therefore triggered by pushing a change to this
file, which also puts every run's parameters under version control.
Bump 'nonce' and push to request another run; set 'enabled' false to
stop the workflow from running on unrelated pushes to its own sources.

_rerun_notes: nonce 3: sdk_query.json gained /usr/lib/swift/libswiftCoreData.dylib and libswiftCloudKit.dylib. The query generator only collected libraries whose install name starts with /, so @rpath-named OS Swift overlays were never asked about. Backtrace.framework links @rpath/libswiftCoreData.dylib NON-weakly, so if that overlay is absent on the device the app dies at launch with nothing in the symbol report to explain it. This run settles both.

nonce 4: the nonce-3 run extracted the cache and wrote the export lists, then died decoding an ipsw UIKitCore --objc dump as strict UTF-8 (0xf2 at offset 5612522). Because that raised inside the same step, the commit was skipped and a successful 5 GB extraction produced nothing. Queries now capture bytes and decode with errors=replace, and the whole query set is wrapped so it cannot discard the export lists.
